Commentary.Commentary: That's all from this game but we are not done yet for the day. A couple of more warm-up games coming your way, India versus England and New Zealand versus Australia, both starting at 6 pm local (2 pm GMT). Please switch tabs and join us for all the action.

For Afghanistan, it didn't go as planned. Given the conditions of the UAE and their experience of playing in this part of the world, everyone thought that the Afghans would be too hot to handle for the Saffas but that was not the case. In the beginning, it appeared that their spinners had things under control and to be honest, they bowled decently too but towards the end, Afghanistan conceded 15-20 runs extra. As far as their batting is concerned, once they lost both their openers early, there wasn't much spark. This is one area where Afghanistan will have to show improvement if they have to trouble the other teams with their bowling.

A valuable outing for South Africa and they will be very pleased with the kind of workout they got! In terms of batting, South Africa were a bit slow to pick up but a decent finish meant that they had a par score on the board. The Proteas then utilized five bowlers and all of them were brilliant. Tabraiz Shamsi, as expected, was the best bowler with a  3-wicket haul. With Kagiso Rabada and Anrich Nortje not participating, South Africa would believe that they have a good backup and depth in their bowling.
Dot ball to end the match! South Africa win by 41 runs! Back of a length, outside off, Mujeeb Ur Rahman goes for a reverse-hit but misses.
Back of a length, on off, Mohammad Nabi pulls it powerfully towards mid-wicket for a single.

A good effort but the ball does not stick! Around off, on a length, Mohammad Nabi lofts this one towards the mid off region. He was looking to clear the man there but he does not get the distance on this. The man backtracks, leaps, gets his fingertips on this but the ball pops out.
OUT! TAKEN! Rashid Khan departs now! Short this time, around off, Rashid Khan lines up and plays a flat-batted shot towards the deep mid-wicket region, where Wiaan Mulder gulps this down.
Commentary.Howout: c Wiaan Mulder b Lungi Ngidi

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller, wider, outside off, Khan looks to drive but misses.
Short of a length, around off, punched to covers for one.
On middle, pushed away to the off side. Just one more over of formality left.
Tossed up, on off, Mohammad Nabi drills it to long on for a single.

OUT! Gulbadin Naib is gone now! Full ball, on off, Gulbadin Naib looks to get under it and go big downtown. But gets the bottom part of his blade as the ball goes high in the air towards extra cover. He comes ahead from long off and takes a fine catch in the end.
Commentary.Howout: c David Miller b Tabraiz Shamsi

Commentary.Commentary: Full ball, on the stumps, Mohammad Nabi sweeps it to short fine leg for a single.
Who walks in now? It is Rashid Khan!
Tabraiz Shamsi fires this wide outside off, Mohammad Nabi skips down the track and just about manages to get bat on that one. Pushes it to point.

SIX! Biggie! Tossed up, on off, Mohammad Nabi makes room and goes inside-out over covers for a maximum. Mohammad Nabi is getting some much-needed boundaries for his confidence. 46 needed off 11 balls.
Short and around off, pulled to the fine leg fielder for a couple of runs.
Good-length delivery, around off, angling in, slower, a swing and a miss from Naib.
SIX! Afghanistan are getting some boundaries now! But, it seems like it's too late! A juicy full toss, around off, Gulbadin Naib gets low and hammers this one well over deep mid-wicket.
Slower, shorter, around off, hooked to the deep square leg fielder on the bounce for one.
Well bowled now! Yorker, outside off, Nabi looks to dig this one out but misses.
SIX! Nicely struck by Nabi! In the arc around off, on a length, Mohammad Nabi whacks this one over the long off fence for a biggie.
A dot to end! Slower, length, outside off, Naib misses his shot.
WIDE. Poor from Dwaine Pretorius as he bowls his third wide of the over! Wider outside off, fuller too, Naib does not play at this. Wided.
Hit down to the left of the long on fielder for a single.
WIDE. Fuller, way outside off, Nabi leaves it.

DROPPED AND SIX! A good effort but it was not enough. On a length, around off, Mohammad Nabi stays back and slams this one towards the long off region. David Miller leaps high, gets his fingertips on the ball, but does not hold on and the ball ricochets past the ropes for a biggie.
Yorker outside off, Nabi looks to dig this out but fails to do so.
WIDE. Outside the tramline on the off side, left alone.
Width offered outside off, Gulbadin Naib slaps this to the long off region for one.
Outside off, hit through mid off for a single.
Another dot ball to end the over! Full, on the stumps, Gulbadin Naib pushes it away towards the on side.
Fuller, again, Gulbadin Naib goes for a big heave again but gets hit on the hands instead. Dot ball.
Full ball, Gulbadin Naib looks to go big dancing down the track but instead the ball hit his pads. The ball deflects away towards short third man for a couple.
Shorter length, Mohammad Nabi goes for the pull shot but gets no timing on that. Gets a single to deep mid-wicket.
Fuller, quicker, Gulbadin Naib nudges it to mid-wicket for a single.
Full ball, on the pads, Gulbadin Naib works it in the gap towards the mid-wicket area and gets a couple.
Fuller, on the stumps, Gulbadin Naib nudges it to square leg for a single.
Shorter, around off, Gulbadin Naib pushes it to point.
Fuller, on the stumps, Mohammad Nabi works it away towards square leg for a single.
On the pads, again, Mohammad Nabi looks to clip it away but the ball hits his pads. Dot ball.
Full ball, on the pads, Gulbadin Naib works it away towards mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE! Tabraiz Shamsi delivers this way down the leg side. Gulbadin Naib leaves it alone. Wide called.
Update from the Group A match between Ireland and Netherlands - The Irish team has registered a thumping 7-wicket win to open its account in the ICC Men's T20 World Cup, 2021.
Shorter, on the pads, Mohammad Nabi looks to nudge it towards the on side but misses. The ball hits his pads and deviates towards the off side. The batters take a leg bye.
Just 4 off the over! On middle, hit to the leg side as Keshav chases after the ball and stops the batters from sneaking a run.
A touch shorter, around leg, nudged to deep square leg and the strike is rotated.
Slower, shorter, around off, gently played to the on side for a run.
A single as this is worked through square leg.
Mohammad Nabi moves to the leg side and Keshav serves a short ball around middle, MN only pushes this to covers.
Tossed up on middle, flicked through square leg for one.
Keshav Maharaj comes back into the attack now.
A really good over by Tabraiz! 2 runs and a wicket off it. Full, on off, eased through mid on for one.
Fuller again, around off, pushed to the cover region.
Tossed up, on middle, defended to the leg side.
Who will come now? Gulbadin Naib it is.

OUT! LBW! That was DEAD PLUMB! Tabraiz Shamsi gets his second and Afghanistan are slipping further down as they lose their sixth. Shamsi floats this one up, lands it fuller around middle and off, Najibullah Zadran lines up to play the sweep shot but misses and gets pinged on the pad. An appeal and the umpire agrees by raising his finger in a jiffy. 95 more needed in 45 balls.
Fuller, around middle, tucked to the left of mid-wicket, who dived that side and made a fine partial stop. One run.
On middle, played to mid-wicket.
Full ball, on the stumps, Mohammad Nabi pushes it to long on for a single. Another good over. Only 4 runs from it.
Shorter in length, wide outside off, Mohammad Nabi looks to cut but misses.
Full ball, on the pads, Najibullah Zadran clips it to deep square leg for a single.
Dwaine Pretorius bangs this short, angling into the body, Najibullah Zadran ducks under it. Dot ball again.
Length ball, on off, Najibullah Zadran stays in his crease and blocks it.
Fuller, outside off, Najibullah Zadran drives it aerially through covers and gets a couple.
Fuller, on off, Mohammad Nabi drives it to the cover fielder in the ring. 100 needed now off 54 balls.
Fuller, on the stumps, Mohammad Nabi gets forward and defends it.
Fuller, on the pads, Mohammad Nabi plays it aerially towards the mid-wicket region and gets a couple.
Flatter, on off, Najibullah Zadran pushes it to point and gets a single.
Fuller, on the pads, Mohammad Nabi clips it to deep square leg for a single.
The skipper, Mohammad Nabi walks out at number 7.

OUT! Tabraiz Shamsi strikes with his first ball! Full ball, on off, Karim Janat looks to sweep it away but gets hit on the pads, Tabraiz Shamsi appeals and the umpire raises his finger! Karim Janat is not happy with the decision as he shows his bat to the umpire. Nevertheless, another wicket for South Africa and Afghanistan are in real trouble now.
Tabraiz Shamsi comes into the attack now.
Good-length delivery, on off, Zadran blocks it out.
Najibullah Zadran is off the mark! Outside off on a length, Zadran works this through covers and comes back for the second run.

DRINKS! Afghanistan also got off to a sedate start just like South Africa, but they have lost quite a few wickets. They are in a spot of bother at 40/4. They need the current pair to stitch a solid partnership, to save the sinking ship. South Africa, on the other hand, have done wonders with the ball. They are clearly holding the upper hand in this game and would look to maintain the same pressure.
Who will walk out now? Najibullah Zadran it is.

OUT! TAKEN! That's a simple take and Asghar Afghan ends his innings here. He never looked settled and has ended up giving a dolly to the fielder. This is bowled on a length, served outside off, Asghar Afghan just chips this one towards point, where the Saffa skipper, Temba Bavuma does not move an inch to pouch this. 106 needed to win in 62 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Temba Bavuma b Dwaine Pretorius

Commentary.Commentary: Three dots! Outside off, fifth stump line, the ball stays a touch low and misses Afghan's attempted slash.
Same line and length as the previous delivery, this time, Asghar Afghan pushes it back to the bowler.
Fuller, outside off, dug out by Asghar to the off side.
Dwaine Pretorius (1-0-12-0) is back into the attack.
Flatter, quicker, on the stumps, Asghar Afghan gets the inside half of his bat as he looks to drive it straight. Gets a single to deep square leg.
Full again, on the stumps, Karim Janat pushes it to long on for a single.
Update from the other warm-up game! Pakistan have reached 42/1 at the end of the Powerplay, chasing a target of 131.
Fuller, on pads, quicker, Asghar Afghan pushes it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller, on the stumps, Karim Janat sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Flatter, outside off, Karim Janat pushes it to point off the back foot.
Fuller ball, on the pads, Asghar Afghan flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Another single as this is punched down to long off.
Fuller, around off, milked down the ground, to long off for one.
On middle and leg, turned away to the leg side.
Slower through the air, fractionally shorter, around off, spins away, Janat knocks this through mid-wicket and returns for the second run.
Fuller, on off, Karim pushes this to covers.
Floated, on middle, nicely nurdled away towards square leg for a run.
A maiden for Bjorn Fortuin! Excellent from the Saffa. Around off, fuller, Janat skips down and tries to flick but misses and pads it away to the off side.
Flatter, shorter, outside off, the cut shot is missed by Karim.
Loopy ball, on off. Janat looks to flick it to the leg side. The ball takes the outside edge and comes back to the bowler.
Floated, full and on off. Janat pushes it towards mid on.
Tossed up, on off. Janat pushes it to covers.
Full and on off. Janat plays it back to the bowler.
On the pads, tucked to mid-wicket for a single.
Floated, full and on off. Janat defends it out.
Another dot ball! Flatter, quicker, on the stumps, Karim Janat looks to work it away but gets the inside edge onto his pads.
Flatter, on the stumps, Karim Janat works it away towards the square leg region. Dot ball.
Asghar Afghan comes in to bat now.

OUT! Keshav Maharaj strikes in his first over! Tossed up, on off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz dances down the track and looks to go big over the leg side. He fails to get the right connection and Heinrich Klaasen in the deep mid-wicket region does well to catch it, staring at the sun.
Commentary.Howout: c Heinrich Klaasen b Keshav Maharaj

Commentary.Commentary: Full ball, on off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz gets across and looks to sweep it away towards the on side. Finds the fielder at short fine leg. Dot ball.
Keshav Maharaj comes into the attack now. He replaces Dwaine Pretorius.
Full ball, on off, Karim Janat drives it to covers. Good comeback by Lungi Ngidi after the boundary on the first ball.
Swing and a miss! Length ball, outside off, Karim Janat goes for a big swing but misses. Dot ball.
Slower full toss, on off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz looks to force it away but gets it only to mid on for a single.
Slower length ball, outside off, Karim Janat taps it to short third man for a single.
Back of a length, outside off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz pushes it to deep point for a single.
FOUR! Smashed! Full ball, on off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz gets under it and smashes it wide of mid on for a boundary.
Lungi Ngidi is back into the attack.
On middle, Karim Janat steps forward and clips this through square leg for two. 12 off Dwaine Pretorius' first over!

Nicely played! Around off, back of a length, Janat waits and steers this in between short third man and backward point. One of the fielders does well to chase this down and slides to pull the ball in. Saves two for his team.
A single now as this is guided to short third man.

SIX! Beautiful shot! Well judged by Gurbaz! It was the slower one, following Rahmanullah Gurbaz as he moved leg side and Gurbaz picks this one off his pads and whips it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Around off, defended out.

Dwaine Pretorius starts with a back-of-a-length delivery, around off, Karim Janat taps this to point for a quick run. A direct hit is scored at the non-striker's end by the point fielder, but Karim Janat was well in.
Dwaine Pretorius comes into the attack now.
A good over by Bjorn, just 3 off it! Flatter, on off, knocked through mid-wicket for one.
A touch fuller, wider, outside off, Karim Janat gets on his knees and attempts to sweep it away but misses.
Karim Janat pushes this to the fielder stationed at cover-point.
Rahmanullah Gurbaz moves leg side to this full ball around off and drills it to long off for a run.
Fuller again, on middle, Janat sweeps this to square leg for a run.
Fuller, floated, around off, kept out nicely by Karim.
Full toss, outside off, Karim Janat punches it to sweeper cover for a single. Good over by Lungi Ngidi.
Length ball, outside off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz pushes it to point for a single.
Full, on off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz drives it to the cover fielder in the ring. Dot ball.
Full, on the stumps, Karim Janat drives it to mid on and takes a single. Off the mark straightaway.
Who will walk out now? Karim Janat it is.

OUT! DRAGGED ON! Both the openers are back in the hut now! Lungi Ngidi strikes and gets his first wicket. Length ball, around off, Hazratullah Zazai looks to push it towards the off side but gets an inside edge onto the stumps. South Africa are off to a flying start.
On a length, on off, Hazratullah Zazai blocks it onto the turf.
Who will bowl from the other end? Lungi Ngidi, it is.
Full ball, on off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz pushes it to the cover fielder in the ring. A successful first over by Bjorn Fortuin.
FOUR! First boundary of the innings! Fuller, on off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz takes a step or two forward and drives it straight past the bowler for a boundary.
Fuller, on the stumps, Rahmanullah Gurbaz plays it back to the bowler.
Rahmanullah Gurbaz walks out at number 3.

OUT! Fantastic catch by Temba! Mohammad Shahzad gets out for a duck on his comeback! Fuller, around off, Mohammad Shahzad drives it powerfully through the line. Temba Bavuma is at short cover and he dives full length to his right to take a sharp catch. Big wicket for South Africa straightaway!
Commentary.Howout: c Temba Bavuma b Bjorn Fortuin

Commentary.Commentary: Bjorn Fortuin bowls this flatter, on the stumps, Mohammad Shahzad gets the inside half of his bat as he looks to work it away.
Tossed up, on middle and leg, Mohammad Shahzad works it away towards the on side.
